_comment: A synthetic naming profile, standing in for a real library's.
The target must not know what AWS or Kubernetes is: it takes whatever
profile it is handed. Its own tests therefore run against a made-up
library, so they exercise the *mechanism* (alias resolution, acronym
casing, ambiguity) rather than any particular vendor's naming — and a
real library's naming is tested where that naming lives.
Shapes deliberately covered, one per real-world case that bit us:
acme_workflows_tasks  multi-word reached by a short alias
acme_searchsvc / acme_db   same type name in two submodules
pipelines         a submodule with no vendor prefix at all
